fields.name: projectId
fields.description: Per-environment scoping key (project id). One row per (projectId, envSlug) pair — same shape as Secret/VerificationTarget. The read+write hooks filter by the active env context so cross-env bindings never bleed.

fields.name: envSlug
fields.description: Per-environment scoping key (canonical or custom env slug: dev/stg/prod/uat/<custom>). Echoed on every PATCH — same rule as Secret.

fields.name: bindingsJson
fields.description: JSON-encoded Record<secretId, targetId[]>. The canonical store for the secret→target binding relationship. UI projections (chip, dropdown, runModelTurn credential resolution) derive from this; the VerificationTarget ruleGroup currently strips credentialId on env-scoped PATCHes, so this row is what makes the UI consistent. '[]' for an empty map, not missing.

fields.name: updatedBy
fields.description: IAM user id of the last editor. Audit only; no read-time gate. Same precedent as MemberProject.updatedBy.

fields.name: environmentId
fields.description: Owning Environment.ItemId for this binding row. Eventually replaces the envSlug scoping key; during the transition both are written and the migration backfills the id from the (projectId, envSlug) pair. The __active__:: sentinel scope (active-env storage hack) is retired separately — active env moves to UserPreference.activeEnvironmentId.
